'''Grymarch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He made his living as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on board [[Carrick Station]].

==Behind the scenes==
Grymarch first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] planetary commendation vendor on board Carrick Station.
